title: A deep learning-based image analysis for assessing the extent of abduction in abducens nerve palsy patients before and after strabismus surgery.
summary: Original full text compares image-analysis-derived abduction measurements with clinical measurements in patients with abducens nerve palsy before/after surgery; it reports measured patient-level performance and postoperative change. The result is an observational measurement validation, not treatment efficacy.
